Chilliwack Proper West covers the western side of Chilliwack's core urban area — established streets with a mix of detached homes, townhouses, and practical access to downtown Chilliwack services. This page is specifically for Proper West, not Promontory or other hillside / south-of-town neighbourhoods.

Buyers often choose Proper West for proximity to shopping, schools, and Highway 1 without leaving the main Chilliwack grid. Parks and everyday amenities are close, and commuting across the Fraser Valley stays straightforward. Ask for current Proper West listings and recent sales if you want urban Chilliwack living west of the downtown core.

blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Chilliwack Proper West

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Chilliwack Proper West are served by Bernard Elementary (45465 Bernard Avenue), Central Elementary, A.D. Rundle Middle School, Chilliwack Middle, and Chilliwack Secondary School in SD33. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Townsend Park (sports fields, baseball diamonds, and stadium), Chilliwack General Hospital medical precinct, Landing Leisure Centre, and District 1881 minutes east. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Route 52 (Evans Road via Hodgins and Ashwell), Route 51 (Vedder/Yale), and quick access to Highway 1 Exit 119 and the Downtown Chilliwack Exchange.

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Chilliwack Proper West are regulated by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan urban residential policies, R1-B/R3 infill zoning around Bernard Avenue and Ashwell Road, and floodplain construction elevation requirements. blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper West Real Estate FAQs

parts.t: What types of homes are for sale in Chilliwack Proper West?

Active MLS® listings in Chilliwack Proper West typically include detached single-family homes on 6,000 to 7,500 sq ft lots, renovated ranchers, infill duplexes and small-lot homes, strata townhomes, and low-rise condos near Hospital Street and Ashwell Road. All listings at the top of this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed.
Which schools serve Chilliwack Proper West in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Chilliwack Proper West include Bernard Elementary (45465 Bernard Avenue), Central Elementary, A.D. Rundle Middle School, Chilliwack Middle, and Chilliwack Secondary School in SD33. Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Chilliwack Proper West?

Residents of Chilliwack Proper West have access to Townsend Park (sports fields, baseball diamonds, and stadium), Chilliwack General Hospital medical precinct, Landing Leisure Centre, and District 1881 minutes east. See our
Chilliwack Proper West Neighbourhood Guide
for detailed park addresses and trail notes.
How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Chilliwack Proper West?

Key road corridors serving Chilliwack Proper West include Yale Road West, Bernard Avenue, Ashwell Road, Hodgins Avenue, Young Road, and Highway 1 Exit 119 (Yale Road / Vedder Road). Public transit connections include BC Transit Route 52 (Evans Road via Hodgins and Ashwell), Route 51 (Vedder/Yale), and quick access to Highway 1 Exit 119 and the Downtown Chilliwack Exchange.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Chilliwack Proper West?

Properties in Chilliwack Proper West are governed by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan urban residential policies, R1-B/R3 infill zoning around Bernard Avenue and Ashwell Road, and floodplain construction elevation requirements. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Chilliwack Proper West freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Chilliwack Proper West are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
